messages:
maya (ml): quick drop-in: ran a short diagnostic to separate numeric quantization errors vs prefill scheduling on the new 13B q4 build. initial observation: huge p99 win but a few reproducible GSM8K failures clustered on long-step arithmetics. artifacts: s3://runs/1769994444/diag

lina (eval): how reproducible? can you attach a single failing trace (prompt + model logits + per-token top5) so we can diff?

maya (ml): yes attaching 3 representative traces. here's the deploy metadata: q4-g128-conv (gptq) deployed to ded-13b-q4-canary at 2024-06-10T09:18:02Z. prefill strategy: greedy early fill enabled (prefill-priority=true), warmup tokens=2500.

anil (infra): did you test with prefill disabled on the same q4 build? we should rule out scheduling causing cache staleness.

maya (ml): scheduled the matrix: (1) float32 baseline (no prefill), (2) float32 + prefill-priority, (3) q4 no-prefill, (4) q4 + prefill-priority. started batch runs: 2k examples each.

tess (research): request: capture per-token cross-entropy and top-1 overlap against float32 on the same seed. plot divergence index over step. if divergence happens right after the prefilled prefix boundary that's a scheduler issue.

lina (eval): added: please bucket by problem type (short-qa, single-op arithmetic, multi-step arithmetic, chain-of-thought). also compute calibration reliability (ECE) per bucket.

maya (ml): running with fixed seeds and beam/temperature parity. quick interim numbers from 500-sample subset:

- float32 (no-prefill): p99=220ms, p50=52ms, gsm8k acc=72.3%
- float32 (prefill): p99=186ms (-15.5%), p50=48ms (-7.7%), gsm8k acc=72.0% (-0.3%)
- q4 (no-prefill): p99=170ms (-22.7%), p50=44ms (-15.4%), gsm8k acc=71.9% (-0.4%)
- q4 (prefill): p99=140ms (-36.4%), p50=37ms (-28.8%), gsm8k acc=70.5% (-2.5%)

moral: biggest accuracy drop when q4 + prefill combined. suggests interaction.

anil (infra): interesting. can you reproduce with reduced group-size (g64) to see if quantization granularity impacts the failure mode? if q4-g64 + prefill reduces errors, it's numeric resolution.

maya (ml): queued q4-g64+prefill run next. also instrumented the prefill scheduler to log whether fallback to conservative path occurred; saw ~3% of requests triggered fallback on q4+prefill during the run (conditions: top1_prob<0.015).

tess (research): that fallback rate is telling. maybe prefill is pushing low-confidence tokens into KV cache which undergo stale reuse. capture topk entropy before and after prefill window to validate.

lina (eval): regarding acceptance criteria: product wants p99 at least -20% and gsm8k drop <0.6% as discussed. track both absolute and relative PPL changes.

maya (ml): added a micro-safety: if token-level top1 prob < 0.02 during prefill, skip caching for that token. I'm running an ablation: q4+prefill with safety-gate on.

anil (infra): resource note: adding g64 variant will need one extra GPU on canary. provisioning now. ops-bot: please annotate canary revs.

ops-bot: canary deploy recorded: ded-13b-q4-canary -> 2024-06-10T09:18:02Z (rev q4-g128-20240610) :white_check_mark:

maya (ml): interim insight from per-token cross-entropy plots: in q4+prefill runs, cross-entropy diverges at token positions roughly 40-70 tokens after the prefilling window ends, consistent with hypothesis of cache misalignment.

tess (research): that pattern points to either KV cache indexing mismatch under quantized keys or numerical underflow in attention scores compounded by cached keys. we should run an instrumented single-step attention dot-prod check comparing float32 vs dequantized q4 keys.

maya (ml): scheduling that microcheck now. also collecting topk overlap heatmaps per-position.

lina (eval): for the final report include: raw traces, position-wise CE deltas, topk overlap, ECE per-bucket, and a small set of human-eval annotations for 50 failures to confirm functional regressions vs harmless wording changes.

kai (product): product note: if the q4+prefill safety-gate recovers most failures with small latency impact, we can ship as progressive rollout with fallback to float32 on /chat/critical. otherwise we need to hold.

amil (infra): typo — anil here. agree. also add an autoscaler rule to limit q4-prefill burst capacity for higher-risk tenants until we have clean metrics.

maya (ml): thanks. I'll post the full 2k-run artifacts when complete (est finish ~4h) and a condensed ops-friendly runbook with rollback thresholds. posting interim logs to s3://runs/1769994444/interim. :hourglass:
